# Asaf Lopez

> Senior Frontend Engineer, Software Architect and AI Engineer with 13+ years building and modernizing web applications for enterprise clients in banking, biotech and wealth management. Angular, React, TypeScript. Based in San Luis Potosí, Mexico; remote-ready for US, EU and LATAM teams. Open to senior frontend, architecture and AI engineering roles, and to helping startups and projects.

## Experience

- SoberanIA — Software Architect / Acting CTO · AI Engineering (Mar 2026 – Present): AI solutions for private-sector enterprises in legal, accounting and healthcare.
- The Web Factory — Full-Stack Developer & Server Operations · Escalation Engineer (Oct 2025 – Mar 2026)
- Globant — Senior Frontend Developer (2017 – 2025): modernization programs for Fortune-scale US clients in finance, biotech and banking.
